text:
maya: Heads-up — I pushed a tiny Terraform change to the staging overlay that rewires where we load the service secret. saw one canary fail right after deploy, can someone take a look? path: `modules/k8s/overlays/staging`

liam: on it. which service is failing?

maya: `api-gateway-canary`. logs show `secret not found` during startup.

liam: quick scan: terraform change renamed the secret resource from `redwood-svc-secret` -> `redwood-svc-secrets` (plural). PR is #4523.

maya: ahhh, that explains it. i updated to match upstream naming convention but missed references in kustomize overlays.

sasha: deploy-bot output from the canary job:
```
deploy-bot: kustomize build overlays/staging | kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f -
Error from server (NotFound): secrets "redwood-svc-secret" not found
```

dev-ops: we have two options: revert TF rename, or create a compatibility secret resource with the old name until we update all overlays. i can patch a tiny terraform add-on to create an alias secret. which do you prefer?

maya: not a huge fan of reverting because naming is more consistent now. leaning toward compatibility alias and then update overlays in a follow-up.

liam: i can update the kustomize overlays today. two places: `overlays/staging/kustomization.yaml` for api-gateway and `overlays/staging/ingress` has a secretRef to the old name.

dev-ops: i'll open a quick terraform patch to create an extra secret named `redwood-svc-secret` that reuses the same data. like:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_secret" "redwood_service_alias" {
  metadata {
    name = "redwood-svc-secret"
    namespace = kubernetes_namespace.redwood.metadata[0].name
  }
  data = kubernetes_secret.redwood_service.data
}
```
This will be a short-lived compatibility shim.

sasha: heads-up: our release gating job checks kustomize in CI; if we fix infra first but not overlays, the promote job will still fail. we should coordinate merging order.

liam: plan: (1) dev-ops deploy alias terraform (canary) (2) i update overlays + open PR linking #4523 (3) run config check in CI (4) remove alias in a follow-up window.

maya: sounds good. tagging @deploy-bot to re-run the canary after alias is applied.

deploy-bot: ack — queued config-check job `canary-config-check/1812345678`

liam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4530 — added overlay fixes and updated comments. please review when you have a sec.

dev-ops: alias applied to staging cluster. canary re-run should be green in ~2 mins.

deploy-bot: config-check passed for overlays/staging.

sasha: nice. once liam's PR merges, we can schedule the alias removal during the next maintenance window.

liam: review ping @maya @sasha — left one small comment about secret path variable, otherwise ready. :eyes:

maya: reviewing now. quick question: do we want a short note in the release gating docs about temporary aliasing?

sasha: yes, add a one-liner in `docs/release-gates.md` under "migration notes" so oncall knows to expect the alias removal.

liam: will do before merge.

maya: thanks all — closing the loop once the merge and remove window are scheduled. :thumbsup:
